notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE FOR “HORNY WARP”
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/f28135598f740fe3faede6c5264191dd44dd9165.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hi everyone! It’s been a while since our last update - time to fix that.[/h3][p]When we finished “Horny Warp”, our team promised to release additional content as a thank-you for your support and interest in the game. Quite a lot of time has passed since then, but we’re still standing by our word: the expansion will happen - [strike]sooner[/strike] or [b]later[/b]. We already have some of the artwork, a clear concept, and the determination to see it through. What remains is the hardest part - managing our resources and time wisely.[/p][p]Right now, the Luminati Games team (in case you missed it, we had to change our studio’s name - the story’s on [url="https://x.com/LuminatiGames"]Twitter/X[/url]) is focused on finishing “Girls, I Just Want to Get PAID”. This game is a little different from “Horny Warp”, but we’re confident it will be just as fun and sexy. So if you’d like to support us, please consider adding “Girls, I Just Want to Get PAID” to your wishlist. We’re hopeful that we’ll be able to share some very good news about the game soon![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3682700/Girls_I_just_want_to_get_paid"][/dynamiclink]Coming back to “Horny Warp” — even though we’re also developing our third game, “Horny Kingdom”, we’re doing our best to prioritize finishing Fuckville’s story. “Horny Warp” will always hold a special place in our hearts, and we want to make sure every promise we’ve made is fulfilled.[/p][p]Very soon, the little wagon you see in the attached image will come to life, and inside it you’ll meet a brand-new character. Until then, thank you so much for your endless support. 
See you soon, friends! ːWarpSmoochː[/p]

notes.title: UPDATE V1.1.0
VOTE ON MORE LANGUAGES!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi, everyone!

Summer is coming to an end, and we hope that each of you spent this season in your own unforgettable way. Our team has also had a chance to rest, and we're continuing our work on "Horny Warp" with renewed energy, as well as working on a new game. But let's skip this for now…[/h3]

[h3]We want to expand the localization for "Horny Warp" and add [b]two more languages[/b]! One of them will be [b][u]SPANISH[/u][/b]. In order to decide on the second language to be added to the game, we want to turn to our community. The options are as follows:
[list]
[*] [b][u]French[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Turkish[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Swedish[/u][/b]
[*] [b][u]Dutch[/u][/b][/list][/h3]
[h3]We’ll be conducting a poll on our Twitter... well, on the “X” website, or whatever it's called now. But in any case, we’re providing the link to the poll below![/h3]

[h3][b][url=https://x.com/LuminatiGames/status/1694054903935582690]https://x.com/LuminatiGames/status/1694054903935582690[/url][/b][/h3]

[h3]If you don't have an account on this website, please leave comments below indicating which language from the list, in your opinion, should definitely receive localization in "Horny Warp."
And even if you're not interested in the poll, you can still click the link and follow us 😉 We’re already busy preparing new materials for publication and will start sharing news actively very soon![/h3]

[h3][b]This won't be the last poll to add a new language[/b]. If you want us to localize "Horny Warp" into your native language, which isn't listed above, feel free to write it in the comments or in response to the tweet. We’ll definitely keep them in mind when choosing the next localization![/h3]

See ya!
The Luminati Games team.

notes.title: WHAT’S NEXT?
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
[h3]We've recovered a bit from the release and decided to write a post about our plans and future content. We thought that the best format for this would be Q&A.
This way we can answer the most frequently asked questions we've seen on our social media. Sooo let's go![/h3]

[h3]Q: How are things going?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Amazing! Insanely amazing! The release of Horny Warp exceeded all of our expectations. And it continues to do so!
We planned to take a month-long vacation, but after all your positive feedback and comments, we just couldn't sit still. Just three days after the release, we were already discussing with the artist what would be added as an update to Horny Warp!
So, thank you all again and again!

[h3]Q: Will there be Steam trading cards for Horny Warp?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Yes, of course! We are working on them right now, and we hope that the trading cards, badges, emojis, and backgrounds will be available in March!

[h3]Q: What can we expect in the update for Horny Warp?[/h3]
[b]A: [/b]First and foremost, we’ll increase the number of scenes. Currently, we plan to add [b]EIGHT H-SCENES[/b] to the game. We’ll also add a [b]NEW GIRL[/b], details of which we’ll share as soon as her concept is ready.
In addition to the eight H-scenes, we’ll add [b]EIGHTEEN static erotic images[/b] that will be an additional reward in mini-games. We’ll also add a new difficulty level in which you’ll earn even more resources to avoid unnecessary grinding.
All of the above will be included in the [b]New Game+ content![/b]

[h3]In addition to the erotic content, we will add:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Text logs for those who want to read the dialogues more carefully.
[*] Saving/loading in dialogue.
[*] Resource indicators next to the girl icons for easier navigation.
[/list]
You believed in us when we made the game, which means we’ll make every effort to make your gaming experience as positive as possible.

[h3][b]Q: What will be in the eight new scenes in the free update?[/b][/h3]
[b]A: [/b]Two of the eight scenes will be related to the new girl. Three scenes will be dedicated to the relationships between Camelia and Bunny, Lilyan and Noelle, Demetra and Harpies. We want to add more relationships between the girls in the world of Horny Warp, and we have several awesome ideas!
The remaining three scenes will be dedicated to the top three hottest girls you have met in the village! [b]Write in the comments who you would like to see in this top.[/b]
(P.S. Scene doesn’t mean penetration. We won't give away Lilyan's virginity that easily. 😈)

[h3][b]Q: When can we expect DLC?[/b][/h3]
[b]A:[/b] First and foremost, we need to make the free update for Horny Warp. We value our players very much, and we want to make this adventure unforgettable with all our might. Therefore, for the next 4+ months, we’ll work hard on the free update. Only after that can we talk more about the DLC.

[h3][b]Q: When will there be news about the next game?[/b][/h3]
[b]A:[/b] As we wrote above, we need to work on the update for Horny Warp first. However, we have already come up with a concept for the next game, and we have something to share!
[list]
[*] The game will be in the sci-fi theme.
[*] We came up with an absolutely hilarious name, which we’ll announce as soon as we set up a Steam page. Trust us, you'll love it.
[*] But the most important news is that we’ll have another person join us in working on the next game. You have probably all seen our cool trailers for Horny Warp and Horny Sekai, as well as noted the polished mini-games. A specialist with 13 years of experience in game development worked on all of this, and he’ll help us make the next game. He has already started collecting concepts for his work, and we can't wait to share them with you! 🥵
[/list]
Phew! It seems like we covered all the important topics! If we didn't answer something - ask your questions in the comments. We'll be happy to answer anything you're interested in.

[h3]Thank you so much for your support. Without it, we wouldn't have achieved such results with our game Horny Warp!

With love, Luminati Games team.[/h3]

[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
[h3]We will start this devlog with the news about delaying the release of “Horny Warp.” If previously we set the release somewhere in January, then now we are ready to announce the exact release date - [u][b]February 17[/b][/u]. [/h3]
Of course, the game will release somewhat later than you expected, but our team needs the time to finish the game without compromising its quality. We are sure you also share our wish for “Horny Warp” to release at its best, and that's why we believe you will understand our decision. To make everyone happy, however, we have prepared a surprise!

[b]We have updated the demo for “Horny Warp”.[/b] You will get one more minigame and the first H-scene with priestess Lilyan. This will help you get a better feel for the game and pass the time until its full release. 
[b]We have also prepared the Mac OS build![/b] Now every owner of Mac OS devices will be able to play the “Horny Warp” demo. The final version of the game will also be compatible with Mac OS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359427/fca6c5bdeddaad9c0c34fc81b0baef3ac7e58cbb.png[/img]

And there's even more good news!
Lately, “Horny Warp” has received an enormous amount of support and attention. This greatly inspired our team, and we have plans to support the game for a long time to come. 
[b]We are going to add one H-scene and one side story for every girl![/b] We won't give any details before the release of the main build, though. Our first priority is releasing “Horny Warp,” and the additional content comes second. 

[h3]We would like to apologize again for the release delay. Anyway, you won't be waiting for long![/h3]
